questions.stem: Why is the wall of the left ventricle thicker than the wall of the right ventricle?

options.text: The left ventricle receives blood at higher pressure from the lungs
The left ventricle needs to pump blood at high pressure to the whole body
The left ventricle holds more blood than the right ventricle
The left ventricle contains oxygenated blood which is heavier

questions.explanation: The left ventricle has a thicker muscular wall because it needs to generate enough pressure to pump blood through the aorta to all parts of the body, which is a much greater distance than the lungs.
